'''Sith Knight''' was the title given to a former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who had completed his or her training with a [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] or another Sith Knight.

==History==
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Sith Knights were less numerous than the [[Sith Marauder]]s, a [[Sith Warrior]] variant. Around this time, a [[Unidentified Sith Knight|Sith Knight]] under the direct command of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] trained the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Voren]].<ref name="TBoDR" />

Much later, the term was used to describe a group of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] force users who served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They participated in the [[Hunt for the Decimator]], under the command of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]].<ref name="SW:GB:CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> Sith Knights were trained at [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temples]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

Sith Knight was also another term for the rank of [[Sith Saber]] within the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="Vortex" /> When the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|''Ship'']] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[41 ABY]], all of the tribe's Sith Knights learned how to navigate the craft.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
During the pre-production of the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], conceptual sketches of a potential "Sith Knight" were produced by Concept Artist [[Ed Natividad]].<ref name="Snaphsot1">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/fun/snapshot/2001/07/snapshot20010727.html|series=Episode I Snapshot|text=Sith Knight}}</ref><ref name="Snaphsot2">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/fun/snapshot/2001/07/snapshot20010731.html|series=Episode I Snapshot|text=Sith Knight Part II}}</ref>

In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]], the Sith Knights were voiced by [[Michael Gough]].<ref name="SW:GB" />
